subject.title: cron.update: converting a recurring job to at skips the one-shot cleanup default

question: Should the cron owner sponsor and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110431 as the canonical fix for the recurring-to-one-shot cleanup transition?
rationale: The issue is protected with `maintainer`, and the open PR changes lifecycle defaults across multiple user surfaces; only an owner can accept that compatibility contract.

options.title: Review the linked fix
options.body: Validate the exact-head transition matrix and land the PR if the service, CLI, and Control UI semantics match the intended one-shot lifecycle contract.

options.title: Request a narrower service-only fix
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a reduced patch if the UI or CLI changes introduce an unwanted compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Review the linked fix
recommendation.body: Validate the exact-head transition matrix and land the PR if the service, CLI, and Control UI semantics match the intended one-shot lifecycle contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently contributed merged work on the adjacent one-shot delete-after-run terminal path.
